babs.1: Following the Sunan of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ
babs.2: What is disliked of asking too many questions
babs.3: Following the actions of the Prophet ﷺ
babs.4: What is disliked of hair-splitting and disputing in knowledge
babs.5: The sin of one who shelters an innovator
babs.6: What is mentioned in censure of mere opinion and strained analogy
babs.7: Whoever compared a known principle to a clear principle whose rulings Allah has explained, so that the questioner understands
babs.8: What is reported about the judges' striving (ijtihad) according to what Allah, the Exalted, has revealed
babs.9: The sin of one who calls to misguidance or establishes an evil practice
babs.10: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "Not for you is the decision at all"
babs.11: His saying, Exalted is He: "And man is ever, most of anything, prone to dispute"
babs.12: His saying, Exalted is He: "And thus We have made you a middle nation"
babs.13: If the official or judge strives and errs
babs.14: The reward of the judge if he strives and is correct or errs
babs.15: Rulings that are known through indications
babs.17: The Prophet's ﷺ prohibition denotes forbiddance (tahrim)
babs.18: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And their affair is consultation among them"
